hero.title: AI Consulting Cost — 2025 Guide
hero.description: AI consulting costs $200–$400/hour or $15,000–$60,000 per project engagement in 2025 depending on scope, firm size, and whether engagement is hourly advisory or fixed-price. Big Four firms charge $350–$800/hr or $100,000–$500,000+.

sections.title: Two variables that determine your AI consulting cost
sections.description: Understanding these drivers helps you evaluate quotes and choose the right engagement model.

items.title: 1. Experience & Track Record
items.description: The most important consultant cost driver is verified experience with the specific AI application being considered. A consultant who has built 20 customer churn models can predict data requirements, common failure modes, and realistic accuracy expectations much more accurately than one who has built two. Domain experience matters: a healthcare AI consultant understands HIPAA, FDA SaMD, and Epic EHR integration in ways a generalist doesn't.
items.label: Expertise Value

items.title: 2. The Implementation Gap
items.description: The most common failure mode in AI consulting is the implementation gap — a high-quality strategy or roadmap that cannot be executed because the consulting firm that built the strategy doesn't implement AI systems. ClickMasters is both an AI consulting firm and an AI development firm — our consulting recommendations have been tested against the reality of implementation through thousands of hours of production AI development.
items.label: Execution Reality

sections.title: The problem with time-and-materials AI consulting
sections.description: Most AI consulting engagements are billed time-and-materials — and the incentive misalignment this creates is significant.

blocks.heading: The longer the project takes, the more the consultant earns
paragraphs: Time-and-materials billing creates no incentive for the consultant to be efficient, and significant incentive (perhaps unconscious) for scope expansion and time extension. A strategy engagement that could be completed in 4 weeks can easily become an 8-week engagement when billed hourly.

blocks.heading: Clients can't predict total cost
paragraphs: A time-and-materials engagement with an estimate of '$100–$150/hr for approximately 200 hours' means your project could cost $20,000 or $30,000 or more — and you have no contractual protection against the higher figure.

blocks.heading: ClickMasters' fixed-price alternative
paragraphs: Every ClickMasters consulting engagement has a fixed total price with defined deliverables. If the engagement takes longer than planned, ClickMasters absorbs the additional time — the client pays the agreed price and receives the agreed deliverables.
